Elon Musk posted on Sunday that he would rename ​the company's AI unit to SpaceXSI ‌after President Donald Trump's push to use the term "super intelligence" instead of "artificial intelligence."

"Yes, we ​will make that change," he ​replied to a user on X asking ⁠him about the possibility of ​renaming SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI. At the time of publication, SpaceXAI's X account had not been changed.

In a ​speech last ​month ⁠to the UN General Assembly, Trump said: "From this point forward, ​all of United States documents, ​and ⁠hopefully the world's will be changed to use the much more accurate term 'super' ⁠as ​opposed to artificial. So ​it's super intelligence.".
Musk did not elaborate on the decision, nor did he offer a potential timeframe for the rebranding.

title: SpaceXAI to be rebranded as SpaceXSI, Elon Musk says
